desc:
🛳️ Welcome to Cruise Ship Simulator! Drive your very own Cruise Ship to stunning ports around the Med or Bahamas. You'll start small and buy new & larger ships like the mighty Oasis Class as you sail around from Port to Port! 

Will you start with the compact yet mighty Allegra class, or command the grandeur of the almighty Vista class? The choice is yours-where will your journey begin?🛳️ 

Want to be the FIRST to know about upcoming updates? Hit the NOTIFY🔔 button!

Enjoying our game & want to support us?
Hit the LIKE👍 button
Join our GROUP🎮
https://www.roblox.com/communities/4795028/Tableboard-Studios#!/about

------------------------------------------------------------

🌊Explore ports across the Med or Bahamas!
💰Earn cash from each port you sail to!
🌟 Become an Elite Captain!
🛳️ Immerse yourself in the realism!
